seasonseries.title: Red Bull New York vs. Toronto FC

keyEvents.text: Richard Eckersley (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal!  New York Red Bulls 1, Toronto FC 0. Bradley Wright-Phillips (New York Red Bulls) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kosuke Kimura with a cross.
Warren Creavalle (Toronto FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal!  New York Red Bulls 2, Toronto FC 0. Ruben Bover Izquierdo (New York Red Bulls) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Goal!  New York Red Bulls 3, Toronto FC 0. Dax McCarty (New York Red Bulls) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Bradley Wright-Phillips.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Armando replaces Ibrahim Sekagya because of an injury.
First Half ends, New York Red Bulls 3, Toronto FC 0.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Gilberto replaces Kyle Bekker.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Dominic Oduro replaces Jackson.
Goal!  New York Red Bulls 3, Toronto FC 1. Jonathan Osorio (Toronto FC) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Justin Morrow with a cross.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Marius Obekop replaces Ruben Bover Izquierdo because of an injury.
Eric Alexander (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Dwayne De Rosario replaces Warren Creavalle.
Nick Hagglund (Toronto FC) is shown the red card.
Substitution, New York Red Bulls. Ian Christianson replaces Bradley Wright-Phillips.
Michael Bradley (Toronto FC) is shown the yellow card.
Jamison Olave (New York Red Bulls) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, New York Red Bulls 3, Toronto FC 1.
